name: 47872 · Rockville, IN
findings: ZIP 47872 (Rockville) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (64% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47872 (Rockville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
